text:
Avery (PM): Quick async — pricing/packaging change: we need explicit owners and current blockers across metering, billing, quotas, and contracts. Can owners pls respond? Need EOD inventory so we can schedule canary.

Raj (Eng): I'm on metering adapter + SDK changes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/meters/pull/412 — awaiting review from @Tomas. Main blocker: refactor touches rpc layer, test flakiness in CI.

Mei (Billing): Billing mapping done for most plans. Open question: enterprise contracted customers with custom rate overrides need manual mapping. Sending list in a sec.

Tomas (Infra): Reviewing Raj's PR. FYI quota-enforcement infra needs a minor schema bump to support per-plan burst credits. Patch in staging. Will try to get review completed today.

Chloe (Legal): Heads up — some existing enterprise contracts include a 'no material change' clause that might require 30-day notice before pricing changes. I can triage affected accounts if you share the list.

Priya (Ops): Canary plan proposal: 5% of requests from non-enterprise orgs for 48h, monitor token-cost delta and error rate. If OK, expand to 25% then full. Need rollback playbook and contact list.

Raj (Eng): CI note — tests failing on seq-len edge case in the adapter. Quick workaround: force-quantize flag off in the canary config until we patch. Patch ETA: tomorrow morning.

Avery (PM): Action items (quick):
- Raj: PR review + CI fix (owner: Raj/Tomas) — ETA tomorrow
- Mei: send list of enterprise overrides (owner: Mei) — ETA today
- Chloe: confirm which contracts need notice (owner: Chloe) — ETA today
- Tomas: push schema bump to staging and prod migration plan (owner: Tomas) — ETA EOD if review goes well
- Priya: prepare canary runbook and monitor dashboard (owner: Priya) — ETA EOD

Mei (Billing): List posted: https://drive.redwood/drive/enterprise-overrides.csv : covers 12 accounts. Marked ones that need legal review.

Chloe (Legal): Acked — will review the 4 flagged accounts and DM @Avery by 16:00 PT.

Tomas (Infra): Small config snippet for canary (staging):
```
canary:
  pct: 5
  flags:
    force_quantize: false
    quota_burst: true
```

Raj (Eng): Re: rollback — my suggestion: feature-flag toggle + immediate traffic reroute to stable model variant. I can add the small endpoint to the routing service today.

Priya (Ops): Added canary dashboard and alert thresholds to the shared dashboard: https://console.redwood/dash/canary-pricing-2024

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered to staging at 1719879000 by Raj (Eng) — job: canary-config-deploy

Avery (PM): Thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker that delays EOD owners list, ping here. Otherwise we'll reconvene async tomorrow AM for go/no-go.

Raj (Eng): small FYI — there is a flaky test pattern, leaving a note in the PR description with reproduction steps.

Mei (Billing): Pinged product-support for billing implications on metered refunds. They said delays could impact invoices for next cycle.

Chloe (Legal): Added a checklist in the doc: contract-notice-steps in the shared folder.

Priya (Ops): Ready to run canary once Raj/Tomas greenlight. :thumbsup:

Avery (PM): Closing loop: owners confirmed. Thanks everyone — will send summary and schedule the first canary tomorrow 09:30 PT.
